extends.description: Template names whose actions sit underneath this file, each a bare name resolved to ~/.lpm/templates/<name>.yml. Earlier templates win over later ones; this file wins over all of them; a template's own extends is not followed.

name.description: Project name. Defaults to the config filename.

root.description: Absolute or ~-prefixed path to the project root. Required for local projects; omitted for SSH projects.

label.description: Display label shown in the UI.

parent_name.description: Makes this file a duplicate of another project: it inherits that project's services, actions, terminals, profiles and zones, and holds only identity fields itself.

worktree.description: Whether this duplicate is managed as a linked Git worktree.

claudeAccount.description: Id of the Claude account (Settings → AI & Integrations) whose login this project's terminals, actions, and AI features use, via CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR. Omit it to use the main login, or set it to "" to force the main login in a duplicate whose parent pins an account. Has no effect on SSH projects — the remote host has its own Claude login.

work_status.description: The project's status badge. Written by the app's status menu; leave it to the app.

label.description: Name of a custom status. Required when state is custom.

since.description: When the state was entered, in milliseconds since the epoch.

ssh.description: SSH connection — services, actions, and terminals run on the remote host over this connection.

port.description: TCP port. Defaults to 22 when omitted.

key.description: Path to an identity file. Leave empty to use ssh-agent or your ~/.ssh/config defaults.

dir.description: Default remote working directory. Must be absolute or ~-prefixed.

actions.description: Commands shown as buttons, menus and terminal launchers.

terminals.description: Deprecated alias for actions with type terminal; entries here default to type terminal. Declare new terminals under actions.

profiles.description: Named subsets of services. `default` is used when no profile is selected.

zones.description: Framed groups of buttons in the header or the footer, 1 to 3 rows tall. An action sits in a zone when its "display" is the zone's name. An entry with "rows" declares the zone; an entry without it only adjusts a zone declared in another config file.

propertyNames.errorMessage: Invalid zone name. It can't be empty, contain ":" or "/", or be "header", "footer", "menu" or "button".

envMap.description: Environment variables passed to the process.

rows.description: Height in rows of the bar the zone sits in. An entry with "rows" declares the zone.

label.description: Name shown in menus. Defaults to the zone's key.

display.description: The bar the zone sits in: "header" (default) or "footer". Footer zones share the footer's position numbering with footer buttons.

position.description: Optional sort key among the items of the zone's bar. Lower values render first; entries without a position fall back to alphabetical order. Floats are allowed so items can be inserted between existing positions without renumbering.

layers.description: Keyed layers a zone can slide between; dots show with two or more. A button joins one with its "layer" key. A button with no "layer", or one naming a layer the zone doesn't have, shows in the first layer (lowest position, ties by key).

propertyNames.errorMessage: Invalid layer key. It can't be empty or contain ":" or "/".

label.description: Name shown left of the dots while the layer is showing. Without one, only the dots show.

position.description: Sort key among the zone's layers. Lower values come first; ties break by key.

cwd.description: Working directory: relative to the project root (ssh.dir on SSH projects), ~-prefixed, or absolute.

port.description: The one port the service listens on. Nonzero ports must be unique across services.

portConflict.description: What to do when this service's port is busy at start. "ask" (default) prompts before freeing it; "free" frees it automatically; "fail" refuses to start.

dependsOn.description: Other services this one needs. They start first (in dependency order) and are pulled in automatically whenever this service starts. No readiness wait; unknown names or cycles are errors.

cmd.description: Shell command to run. May be left out when the entry has sub-actions, or when it only adjusts an entry declared in another config file.

label.description: Button label. Defaults to the key.

emoji.description: Optional emoji shown as the action's icon and on the terminal tab it launches.

color.description: Optional accent color for the button and the terminal tab it launches. A named accent adapts to the theme: red, orange, claude, amber, yellow, lime, green, emerald, teal, cyan, sky, blue, indigo, violet, purple, fuchsia, pink, rose, slate, gray or stone; add -deep for a darker tone (e.g. blue-deep). Any other value is used as a CSS color (e.g. #8b5cf6).

shortcut.description: Optional keyboard shortcut that runs the action while the project is open, e.g. "cmd+shift+b". Needs cmd (ctrl counts as cmd) or alt, optionally shift, and exactly one key.

cwd.description: Working directory: relative to the project root (ssh.dir on SSH projects), ~-prefixed, or absolute. Sub-actions inherit it.

port.description: Port(s) that must be free before it runs. Accepts a single port, an inclusive range string like "3002-3010", or a list mixing both. Busy ports are handled per "portConflict".

portConflict.description: What to do when a declared port is busy. "ask" (default) prompts before freeing it; "free" frees it automatically; "fail" refuses to run. Sub-actions inherit it.

confirm.description: Ask before running. In a file that adjusts an entry declared elsewhere, false leaves the other file's value in place.

display.description: Where the button appears. Defaults to "header" when omitted. "footer" pins it to the footer; any other name puts it in the zone of that name (see "zones"), or in the header when no such zone exists. "menu" is still accepted but no longer suggested.
display.errorMessage: Invalid "display" value. Use "header", "footer" or a zone name without ":" ("button" → use "header").

layer.description: Which layer of its zone the button sits in. Applies only when "display" names a zone with layers. Without it, or naming a layer the zone doesn't have, the button shows in the zone's first layer.

position.description: Optional sort key. Lower values render first; entries without a position follow in alphabetical order. Inside a zone it orders the zone's buttons. Floats are allowed so items can be inserted between existing positions without renumbering.

primary.description: For an action with sub-actions: which sub-action the button's main part shows and runs. "last-used" follows your most recent pick; a sub-action key always shows that one. The arrow still opens the full list.

type.description: How it runs. Omit for a one-shot with streamed output; "terminal" opens the command in a terminal tab; "command" submits the command into the currently focused terminal; "background" runs it hidden with a completion toast. Sub-actions inherit it.

reuse.description: With type terminal: reuse the terminal this action already opened instead of opening another. In a file that adjusts an entry declared elsewhere, false leaves the other file's value in place.

mode.description: Where it runs on SSH projects. "remote" (default) runs over ssh on the host; "sync" rsyncs ssh.dir into a local mirror, runs locally, then rsyncs changes back — useful when you want local tools (e.g. your local Claude Code) to act on remote files. Sub-actions inherit it.

prompt.description: Task submitted to the AI agent a terminal action launches (claude, codex, gemini, ...) once the agent is ready. {{key}} input placeholders are filled in.

inputs.description: Values asked for before it runs. {{key}} in cmd, cwd, env values and prompt is replaced by the answer.

actions.description: Sub-actions: a split button when cmd is set, a dropdown otherwise. They inherit cwd, env (merged key by key), mode, type and portConflict.

label.description: Prompt label. Defaults to the key.

default.description: Initial value. For a radio input it must match an option value.

persist.description: Remember the last value entered for this input and pre-select it next time (per project + action), overriding "default" once a value has been chosen. Ignored for password inputs.

position.description: Order of the prompt. Inputs with a position come first, lowest first; the rest follow in key order.

options.description: Choices for a radio input: plain strings, or { label, value } mappings.
